environment_setting: Country B, City X, where citizens are generally law-abiding but occasional conflicts arise in crowded public places
norm_base: Citizens Beating others or intentionally causing bodily harm Detention for 5-10 days and fine of 200-500 yuan; for minor cases, detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.legitimate_action: walking away from a potential conflict
legitimate.benefits: avoiding legal trouble, maintaining personal safety
legitimate.costs: feeling of humiliation, perceived loss of respect

illegal.illegal_action: physically assaulting the person causing conflict
illegal.benefits: immediate sense of satisfaction, perceived gain of respect
illegal.costs: detention for 5-10 days and fine of 200-500 yuan

legitimate.costs: risk of personal harm, time and effort spent

illegal.illegal_action: ignoring the conflict and walking away
illegal.costs: feeling of guilt, potential escalation of conflict

legitimate.legitimate_action: calling the police to handle the situation
legitimate.benefits: professional handling of the conflict, maintaining safety
legitimate.costs: time delay, potential criticism for not intervening directly

illegal.illegal_action: physically intervening and using excessive force
illegal.benefits: immediate resolution of the conflict, perceived as taking charge
illegal.costs: detention for 5-10 days and fine of 200-500 yuan
